100561.title: Road handlebar component arrangement
guidance: Inspect 1 EA Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) and 1 EA Stem (Product Number SM-9087) for visible damage.
Use an assumed padded assembly jig to position Stem (Product Number SM-9087) at the center of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) for illustration only; the fastening method is not supplied.
Demonstrate wrapping 40 IN of LL Grip Tape (Product Number GT-0820) over the two grip areas, with the distribution and overlap treated as demo assumptions.
Demonstrate positioning 2 EA Road End Caps (Product Number EC-R098) at the open ends; the detailed retention method is not supplied.
